newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkey, northern Cyprus to sign economic protocol.
newsitem.headline: Turkey, northern Cyprus to sign economic protocol.

text.p: Turkey and the breakaway republic of northern Cyprus are to sign an economic protocol on Friday to help the northern part of the divided island, a Turkish Cypriot official said on Thursday.

"When preparing this protocol our aim was to bring northern Cuprus's economy to a position where it can stand on its own two feet," Anatolian news agency quoted Dervis Eroglu, the prime minister of the breakaway state recognised only by Turkey, as saying after his arrival in Ankara.
"All kinds of ideas have gone into the draft protocol to find a solution to the economic problems of northern Cyprus," Eroglu said without giving further details.
Cyprus has been divided since 1974, when Turkish troops occupied the northern third of the island in response to a short-lived Greek Cypriot coup engineered by a junta then ruling Greece.
